title: Refund policy
text: Customers may request a refund within 30 calendar days of delivery. The item must be unused and in its original packaging. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Subscription cancellation
text: A subscription can be cancelled from Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription. Access continues until the end of the current paid billing period. Cancellation does not automatically issue a refund.

title: Password reset
text: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page. Password-reset emails expire after 15 minutes. Support staff will never ask for a password or reset code.

title: Product warranty
text: ExampleCo hardware has a limited one-year warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage, loss, misuse, and normal wear are excluded.

title: Support hours
text: Live support is available Monday through Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 UTC, excluding published company holidays. Self-service help is available at all times.

title: Shipping
text: Standard shipping normally takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally takes 1 to 2 business days. Tracking is emailed after dispatch.

title: Data retention
text: Support chat transcripts are retained for 90 days for quality review and then deleted, unless a legal hold requires longer retention. Customers may request access or deletion through the privacy form.
